analysis.session_summary: Overnight tape was a low-conviction USD grind: DXY rose 9.5 points to 99.446, USD/JPY added 19.0 pips to 159.87, and USD/CHF added 14.9 pips, while SPX edged up 6.3 points and VIX fell 6.6 points to 16.575. The commodity complex diverged: Brent gained 110.2 cents to 93.841, AUD/USD was flat at 0.71675, but NZD/USD fell 11.1 pips. Most legs carried no clear catalyst, with only the Japan FinMin Katayama coordinated-FX headline leaving a measurable footprint in USD/JPY and USD/CHF. The tape reads as risk-on USD strength against low yielders and NZD, with flow/technical moves dominating.

themes.evidence: DXY +9.5 points to 99.446; USD/JPY +19.0 pips; USD/CHF +14.9 pips; SPX +6.3 points; VIX -6.6 points.
Brent +110.2 cents (+1.188%) to 93.841; AUD/USD unchanged at 0.71675; NZD/USD -11.1 pips to 0.59075; AUD/NZD +22.6 pips.
Most major legs show no clear catalyst; Japan FinMin Katayama at 04:00 produced measurable USD/JPY +5.0 pips in 15 min, 24% of that leg.

leg_notes.EUR/USD: EUR/USD chopped down-up-down to close -10.8 pips at 1.16057, only 0.13 within a 21.5-pip range, with no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.GBP/USD: GBP/USD traced a down-up-down sequence to close -6.0 pips at 1.35426, near the lower end (0.21) of a 21.1-pip range with no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.AUD/USD: AUD/USD closed flat at 0.71675 after down-up-down-up legs, ending 0.27 within a 17.7-pip range; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.NZD/USD: NZD/USD fell 11.1 pips to 0.59075, closing only 0.08 in a 23.2-pip range after a down-up-down sequence; no clear catalyst.
leg_notes.USD/JPY: USD/JPY rose 19.0 pips to 159.87, closing 0.96 in a 24.3-pip range; the FinMin Katayama headline contributed +5.0 pips in 15 min to the 02:15-06:45 up leg.
leg_notes.USD/CHF: USD/CHF added 14.9 pips to 0.80964, near the top (0.86) of a 22.8-pip range; FinMin Katayama added +2.7 pips in 15 min to the last up leg.
leg_notes.USD/CAD: USD/CAD rose 6.5 pips to 1.38664, near the top (0.84) of a 25.1-pip range, with no clear catalyst.

polarity_reads.event: Japan FinMin Katayama: Confirmed with Bessent, Continued, Coordinated Measures on FX Needed
polarity_reads.read: The 04:00 headline produced +5.0 pips in USD/JPY within 15 min (24% of the 02:15-06:45 up leg) and +2.7 pips in USD/CHF (16% of that leg), while GBP/USD slipped -3.1 pips; this shows the market treated coordinated FX jawboning as USD-supportive/JPY-negative rather than risk-off.

scenarios.name: USD drift extends
scenarios.thesis: Overnight USD strength (DXY +9.5 points to 99.446) continues into US data; ISM Manufacturing PMI forecast 55.2 vs previous 55.6 remains expansionary and supports USD, with risk-on limiting haven demand.
triggers: EUR CPI Flash y/y prints 3.3% or lower
US ISM Manufacturing PMI prints at/above 55.2
scenarios.invalidation: A break below DXY 99.446 on a EUR upside surprise or ISM below 55.2 undermines the drift.

pair_paths.rationale: Overnight range 21.5 pips and close 0.13 in range favor extension lower on USD strength.
Overnight range 24.3 pips and close 0.96 in range show USD/JPY ended near highs.
Overnight range 22.8 pips and close 0.86 in range support follow-through.

scenarios.name: Risk-on consolidation / USD mixed
scenarios.thesis: Equities and Brent remain supported (SPX +6.3, Brent +110.2 cents), and AUD flat; high-beta/commodity FX recover while USD gains against low yielders stall.
scenarios.invalidation: A resumption of broad USD buying or a sharp risk-off would turn EUR/USD lower and AUD/USD down.

pair_paths.rationale: AUD/USD closed flat at 0.71675, near mid-range 0.27, and risk-on tone supports a bounce.
NZD/USD closed only 0.08 in a 23.2-pip range, leaving room for mean reversion.
Close 0.13 in range with no clear catalyst keeps EUR/USD two-way within its 21.5-pip overnight range.

scenarios.name: EUR CPI upside / USD pullback
scenarios.thesis: EUR CPI Flash Estimate y/y forecast 3.3% vs previous 2.9% could surprise to the upside, lifting EUR and forcing DXY to unwind overnight gains.
triggers: EUR Core CPI Flash Estimate y/y prints above 2.5%
EUR CPI Flash Estimate y/y prints above 3.3%
US ISM Manufacturing PMI prints below 55.2
scenarios.invalidation: A soft EUR CPI or strong US data keeps DXY bid and EUR/USD near lows.

pair_paths.rationale: A hotter EUR CPI could lift EUR from a close 0.13 in range toward the top of its 21.5-pip overnight range.
USD pullback after ISM miss could push USD/JPY back through its 24.3-pip overnight range.

risks.risk: EUR CPI Flash Estimate y/y forecast 3.3% vs previous 2.9%; Core CPI Flash Estimate y/y forecast 2.5%
risks.why_it_matters: A surprise above forecast could unwind USD strength and lift EUR/USD from its 0.13 close-in-range.
risks.watch: Core CPI Flash Estimate y/y and headline CPI Flash Estimate y/y at 11:00.

risks.risk: US ISM Manufacturing PMI forecast 55.2 vs previous 55.6
risks.why_it_matters: The high-impact print can confirm or reverse overnight USD gains in USD/JPY and USD/CHF.
risks.watch: ISM Prices forecast 70.5 vs previous 71.1 and JOLTS forecast 7.33M vs previous 7.36M.

risks.risk: Low-liquidity overnight flow with no clear catalysts
risks.why_it_matters: Moves like USD/SEK +222.8 pips and USD/NOK +75.2 pips may be exaggerated and prone to reversal.
risks.watch: VIX at 16.575 and DXY at 99.446 as risk anchors.

risks.risk: Brent rally and Hormuz tanker headline at 01:00
risks.why_it_matters: Further oil gains can support NOK and CAD and weigh on risk-sensitive FX.

analysis.calendar_ahead_note: EUR CPI Flash Estimate y/y at 11:00 (forecast 3.3%, previous 2.9%) and Core CPI at 2.5% can reprice ECB expectations; US ISM Manufacturing PMI at 16:00 (forecast 55.2, previous 55.6) plus ISM Prices and JOLTS are the main USD volatility events.
